text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 detected — 5.3% error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Trigger: 5xx rate > 5% for last 5m. Paging on-call: @maya. Inc ID: INC-2026-17832

maya: Acked. I'm on it. Joining war room. Can someone drop a Zoom?

trent: I'll take customer comms. @maya please confirm scope (all tenants or specific?). Assign runbook owner: @samir.

samir: Paging confirmed with PagerDuty. Oncall is @oncall-sre (Leah). I can take root cause triage. War room: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=warroom (pw: redwood123) — room 'inc-redwood-usw2'.

leah: Oncall here (Leah). I got the alert at 1783200003. I see elevated 500s from inference-runtime nodes: g2-7-pool-usw2. Will collect logs and start mitigation.

maya: repro locally? I see a spike in KV cache misses. Dumping last 2k log lines.

samir: logs snippet:
```text
2026-10-01T12:45:02Z inference-runtime g2-7: ERROR tokenization failed: out of memory
2026-10-01T12:45:03Z inference-runtime g2-7: WARN batch failed: kv-cache restore timeout 3002ms
2026-10-01T12:45:05Z router us-west-2: 502 upstream read timeout
```

trent: Draft status page update (internal review):
"Title: Degraded API responses in US-WEST-2
Impact: Customers in us-west-2 may experience 502/500 errors when calling /v1/generate. We are actively investigating and have mitigations in progress.
Mitigation: Rolling restart of affected inference pool and temporary routing to standby capacity.
ETA: updates every 15 minutes."

leah: I'll start rolling restart. Plan:
- Mark pool g2-7 as draining
- Drain connections
- Restart process on 3 nodes at a time
- Monitor 5xx rate and latency
Command:
```bash
# cordon + drain
redwoodctl pool cordon g2-7 --region us-west-2
redwoodctl pool drain g2-7 --batch-size 3
# restart
redwoodctl node restart --pool g2-7 --node-list $(nodes) --parallel 3
```

maya: Also open fallback: route new requests to model-variant quantized-v2 as temporary fallback. Can we enable routing policy?

samir: Enabled fallback route to quantized-v2 for us-west-2 by traffic-weight 30% -> 0.3. (command applied). Monitoring.

status-ops-bot: Scheduled status update posted to status.redwood.ai: "Degraded API responses in US-WEST-2 — We're investigating. Next update in 15 minutes." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-17832

trent: Customer notification draft for enterprise list (please vet):
"Hello — We're investigating increased 5xx errors affecting text generation in us-west-2. Our engineers are rolling restarts and routing traffic to standby capacity. No data loss expected. We'll follow up within 15 minutes. If you're seeing critical impact, reply to this thread or DM @trent."

maya: Internal postmortem notes to capture:
- root cause hypothesis: KV cache eviction + oom when simultaneous large batch requests + quantization memory pressure
- key mitigation: routing + rolling restart + temporary traffic-weight change
- owner: oncall (Leah) + eng-runtime (Samir) + SRE (Maya)

leah: Restarting node batch 1 now. 2/3 nodes restarted. 5xx rate dropping from 5.3% -> 2.1% in last 2m.

samir: Verified that fallback is serving 18% of traffic. Latency is slightly higher but 5xxs reduced.

trent: Sending customer notif to enterprise list now. Pasting sent message below:
"Sent to enterprise-notify@redwood.com:
Subject: Incident - Degraded API responses in US-WEST-2
Body: We're seeing elevated 5xx errors on /v1/generate for us-west-2. Workarounds applied: routing to standby variant and rolling restarts. Next update in 15 minutes. Contact support if you have high-priority disruptions."

maya: Confirmed mitigation working. Suggest hold war room and continue monitoring. If no regression in 30m, we transition to monitoring/owner handoff.

leah: Agree. Jumping to monitoring. I'll follow up with handoff at +30m and file INC-2026-17832 in ops-tracker.

incident-bot: Incident state changed: Mitigation in progress -> Stabilizing. Page suppressed.

trent: Thanks team. Quick checklist for post-incident:
- handoff note + timeline
- status page final update
- customer follow-up summary
- postmortem owners: Maya, Samir, Leah
- follow-up action: add autoscaling + KV-cache tuning to runbook

samir: Added a ticket to eng-runtime: RT-4572 "KV cache guardrails and OOM prevention" — link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/RT-4572

maya: End of thread. Good work. :thumbsup:
